tester: Codex: automated regression and isolated Mac IDEA UI checks
environment: macOS, isolated IDEA Community 252; Linux Actions runs JDK 17, IDEA verifier and Chromium

install_startup.evidence: Native UI checks used the earlier QA plugin identity. Renamed identity and installable ZIP were checked in Gradle sandbox/CI. The 0.1.0 version-only rebuild is not a new full native installation acceptance.

real_account_content.evidence: No real member credentials or paid-content acceptance. Anonymous bank/question lists and login-required state were exercised.

navigation_shortcuts.evidence: Native bank/question selection, Enter opening, return-to-list, A+ and More menu were exercised. Automated tests cover table activation/navigation; full user keymap acceptance was not performed.

markdown_images.evidence: Labeled local Markdown/code/table/image fixture and independent native image window exercised; browser regression covers nine image interactions. These do not replace real account-content validation.

settings_persistence.evidence: Font changes and More menu size were observed. Full restart/settings migration acceptance for the new 0.1.0 installation was not performed.

limitations: Early 0.1.0 release: real member accounts and paid content are not accepted as verified.
Native UI evidence used a prior QA identity; new identity/package are checked automatically, not claimed as full real-install acceptance.
Declared IDEA range is 213–252; 2026.1/261 is excluded and JCEF is required.

New plugin ID io.github.ataraxyadong.devreader does not inherit old settings/login/keymap. User handles old-plugin uninstall. Avoid simultaneous use with integrated reader containing identical Java services.
